note: Three-section campground along the Meramec River. Section 1's electric/water pull-through sites 114-125 sit between the loop road and a wooded river bank; Section 2's riverside sites 2-19 face the river across the loop road. Some sites may be unavailable in the rainy months. Watercraft and ATV trailers may be parked off the pad in the grass. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +14, full hookup +20 (2026 = 2027), 50A/water/sewer, FCFS after cutoff; added 197 sites (pads 35-90 ft), showers/flush/vault/laundry/dump/water/store, military $2, 12-month window, 15-in-30, reservations Mar 1-Nov 30. Riverview confirmed (riverfront lead for Section 1's 114-125). Pin ~220 m from the sites' centre: fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview kept (Meramec River, 60-70 m wide - a river). Section 2's river row (sites 002-019, sewer/electric/water) are back-ins angled off the loop road, which runs between the pads and the bank (leaf-off Esri imagery) - riverview at best. Section 1's electric/water pull-throughs 114-125 sit EAST of their loop road (park's Section 1 map and imagery), ~10-20 m from the water, but across a wooded strip down a bank ~4 m high (EPQS pads 177.1-177.4 m vs river 172.9-173.1 m) - a climb-down bank, not an open apron, so not riverfront on this evidence. Lead: an official site photo of 118-124 showing open, walkable bank could earn riverfront for those few. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri leaf-off imagery + UseDirect points + park maps 2026-11-07: Sec 2 river sites 002-019 across the loop road; Sec 1 114-125 river side of road but ~4 m wooded bank -> riverview'.
